question: Who among the following was the last Mauryan ruler and was killed by his commander-in-chief?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Brihadratha__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brihadratha, the 9th and final Emperor **of the Mauryan Empire, reigned from **187 to 185 BCE**. The empire's territories, centered around the capital of Pataliputra, had expanded significantly since the time of Ashoka.
 
• However, Brihadratha's rule came to an abrupt end when he was overthrown and assassinated by his General, Pushyamitra Shunga.
 
• Following Brihadratha's demise, Pushyamitra Shunga established the Shunga Empire, marking the end of the Mauryan dynasty.
 
• Mauryan Empire had reached its zenith under Ashoka, the grandson of Chandragupta, during his reign from 269 to 232 BCE.
 
• According to the Puranas, Brihadratha ascended to the throne following his father Shatadhanvan's reign. He ruled for a period of three years before his downfall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Mauryan Empire,** an ancient Indian dynasty, spanned from 322 BCE to 185 BCE. **Shatadhanvan,** also known as Shatadhanus, served as the 8th Emperor of the Maurya dynasty, reigning from 195 to 187 BCE. According to the Puranas, he succeeded Devavarman Maurya and ruled for a duration of eight years.
 
• **Bindusara,** the son of Chandragupta Maurya, ascended to the throne as the second Mauryan emperor of Magadha in Ancient India. His reign contributed to the expansion and consolidation of the Mauryan Empire.
 
• **Dasharatha,** a figure from Hindu mythology, was the king of the Kosala kingdom and a descendant of the Suryavamsha dynasty. He ruled from his capital in Ayodhyā and is notably known as the father of Lord Rama, the central character in the epic Ramayana.
